description: The certified base with exactly ONE class layer swapped: every present built-in-category GStyleElem row (1,172) -> OUR row of the same (category, style-type), in place, nothing else touched (no settings, no palette). if_FAIL: Our catalog VALUES are rejected in isolation -- diff a rejected (category, type) row's pen / colour / pattern values against the base's row (report's field diff sample).
